title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Centered on Chevron Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom with this custom-designed comforter set from Jeminise, perfect for truckers and truck enthusiasts alike. Featuring a bold design tailored to the trucker lifestyle, this high-quality bedding adds a modern, personal touch to any space, making it a thoughtful gift for family, friends, or yourself.

Key Features

  • Customizable Design: Personalization options are supported with custom text input to create a truly unique bedding piece.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to ensure a lightweight, comfortable, and durable sleep experience.
  • Vibrant & Durable: Advanced digital printing methods keep the colors vivid and prevent fading, with fine, compact stitching along the edges for lasting durability.
  • Complete Set Options: Available as a duvet cover or comforter set with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheets to suit your needs.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; air dry or tumble dry on low heat to keep the microfiber fluffy and soft.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Cool Flag Trucker
Pattern Cartoon
Theme Trucker
Style Modern
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Customization 1 text input
Care Instructions Machine Wash
